visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of several cantaloupes wrapped in green protective mesh, sitting on black plastic crates. A price tag of 1590 yen is visible. (2) The scene transitions to a wide shot of a supermarket aisle with bright white flooring marked with red directional arrows. Various shelves with price tags and product displays are visible on both sides under bright overhead lighting. (3) An exterior daytime shot shows a large commercial building named 'Yodobashi-Camera' with multiple store logos like 'Lopia' and 'Daiso' displayed on its facade. (4) The camera moves to a shot looking up an escalator towards a Lopia supermarket entrance on the 4th floor. (5) Inside the store, shots showcase various sections: rows of fresh vegetables like potatoes and leeks, followed by a fruit section featuring peaches, pears, and watermelons. (6) A refrigerated section displays rows of packaged desserts and yogurts, and another area shows prepared meals in plastic containers sitting on wooden barrels. (7) The final shot is a nighttime view of the brightly lit Yodobashi-Hakata building with glowing electronic signs and advertisements.
